1 · How the engine works

The engine treats Moves like a consulting brain: discover what the client has, collect the current-state comprehensively, reason to a recommendation, and answer with grounded authority.

2 · The two-axis model (the key generalization)

What evidence a phase requires is not hardcoded. The archetype says what kind of evidence the work needs; the client’s real estate decides which specific instrument applies. Same requirement (“engineering delivery baseline”) resolves differently per estate.

3 · The universal 7-phase spine

Every Move runs the same spine. The archetype fills the content; the spine guarantees the flow — each phase inherits a frozen contract, collects, derives, and emits for the next.

Dark = built & live-proven · grey = spine-ready (archetype declares them; engine reuses the same machinery)

P3–P5

Design → Roadmap/Business-Case → Mobilize → Handoff

SPINE-READY
Derive / produce (declared by archetype)
  • Target operating model · AI-enabled SDLC architecture
  • Roadmap (work-packages) & estimate phased by it ($1.4–2.3M on the live move)
  • Business case · mobilization · Tower handoff
How
  • Reuses the same engine + method library
  • Each deliverable carries a quality rubric + the no-fabrication refinement contract
  • Estimate ties to the roadmap (no “floating” numbers)
Continuity: each phase consumes the prior phase’s typed output (ValueTree → CapabilityGaps → WorkPackages → Estimate) — nothing already known is re-asked.

5 · The governed evidence ladder (honest, promotion-only)

Every piece of evidence carries its true state. agent_ready is reachable only through the governed promotion workflow — never automatically. Nothing is silently “loaded.”

6 · Live outcomes — the real move 0d14fa63

A real, non-seeded SkyHarbor move (“AI-Powered Product Development Lifecycle”), originated through the product and advanced through the real P0→P1 gate. The defining behavior: it cites what it knows and refuses what it doesn’t.

“Enhance quality” sharpens narrative, structure, depth and audience — but cannot add a fact not in the evidence. The contract is structural, not a guideline.

9 · The quality bar (scored on every change)

✓ Grounded-or-silent — cite or flag missing
✓ Computed-not-asked — where-to-start derived
✓ Archetype-driven — no hardcoded domain vocab
✓ Continuity — consumes prior phase output
✓ Tenant-safe — no cross-tenant context
✓ Honest ladder — promotion-only, never auto
✓ Cross-industry — passes the swap test
✓ Felt rigor + control — grounding visible

10 · Honest known gaps (the next builds)

  • Richer ladder states indexed → agent_ready need the promotion workflow wired (the data model + UI already represent them honestly; nothing auto-promotes).
  • Live LLM Nexus/Sentinel answers should route through the GroundedAnswer contract — the deterministic seam is the floor + test harness today.
  • Per-move archetype selection (default AI-PDLC); CSV ingest wired for more families (CMDB, workforce); more archetypes.
  • Enrichment writeback — completed Moves enrich the archetype (the self-improving flywheel).
